text:
Priya: Kicking off onboarding for Cinderwave — quick sync on stakeholders, measurable success criteria, and a 30-day timeline. Planning a 30-min runbook sync today at 2:00pm PT. Who from our side can join? @Eli can you confirm SSO progress? cc: @Jorge @Nora

Eli: SSO work is underway, target to finish Thu 3/26. I can join the 2pm call.

Jorge: I'll cover data ingestion, sample prompts, and integration tests. Need the sample dataset from their engineers by Wed so we can pre-run evaluation. @Maria can you confirm the data spec was sent?

Maria: Sent the initial data spec yesterday to their tech lead, waiting on legal for sample export sign-off — expect confirmation by Thu EOD. :thumbsup:

Sam_Cs: Cinderwave will have their eng lead + PM on the 2pm call. For success criteria from their side: 1) end-to-end flow working in a staging env, 2) median latency < 300ms for simple prompts, 3) integration tests >= 90% pass. Does that align with our pilot goals?

Priya: That aligns. Adding one business-level KPI: target 10% support deflection within 30 days post-launch. We'll instrument analytics to measure. tagging @analytics-team for dashboard.

Nora: For enablement I propose two sessions: Dev deep-dive (implementation) and Product owner walkthrough (features/metrics). I'll draft invites and two 45-min sessions.

Priya: Risks to flag: customer mentioned a likely budget freeze after the pilot window — treat renewal risk as elevated until we show ROI. Action: capture usage targets and expected cost savings by EOW. Owner: Jorge.

Jorge: Ack. I'll prepare a short pricing + usage expectation doc and share by Friday.

Eli: Infra note: recommend dedicated capacity for consistent latency during pilot. I'll include a cost estimate (hourly + projected tokens/day).

Maria: I'll own feedback capture. Plan: short post-demo survey and a 3-week check-in. Draft survey template below:

```text
- What worked well?
- Where did you hit friction?
- Likelihood to recommend (0-10)
- Key blockers to adoption
```

Priya: Nice. Concrete next steps: 
- 1) 2pm sync today (invite sent)
- 2) sample data delivered by Thu EOD (Cinderwave)
- 3) SSO + infra readiness by Thu (Eli)
- 4) Pricing & usage targets doc by Fri (Jorge)
- 5) Enablement invites by Mon (Nora)
Owners noted, will track in the kickoff playbook. :white_check_mark:

Sam_Cs: Thanks all — looking forward to the call. Will prioritize sample dataset delivery and loop in legal.

Priya: Thanks team. I'll post meeting notes + action tracker after the 2pm sync. Please add any blockers to the thread.
